opportunities.name: Ap Barrage Repeat
opportunities.objective: Log W on-hit packets during Dusk and fully stacked Rageblade.
opportunities.mechanic: W supplies eight seconds of AP-scaled max-health magic On-Hit and extra range; Q removes both resists. Nashor/Dusk/Rageblade tests a personal on-hit attack window with AP scaling and Phantom Hit, without assigning passive death damage to attacks.
opportunities.requiredState: W active and Q shred lands; record Rageblade ramp and Dusk availability.
opportunities.failure: Low defense or delayed attacks wastes the eight-second duration.
opportunities.test: Log W on-hit packets during Dusk and fully stacked Rageblade; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated on-hits do not grant extra W duration or attack range.

opportunities.name: Artillery Threshold Reveal
opportunities.objective: Compare R damage at 41% versus 39% while recording cast costs.
opportunities.mechanic: R doubles its base packet below 40% target health and Shadowflame uses the same threshold for magic damage. E slow and Q shred improve a follow-up artillery aim; Seraph provides finite mana and Horizon adds long-range reveal for subsequent shots.
opportunities.requiredState: Enemy below 40%; track R casts within eight seconds and actual mana. Earn Seraph transformation through recorded Tear stacks before using this six-slot state.
opportunities.failure: Escalating R cost reaches 400 and misses exhaust mana.
opportunities.test: Compare R damage at 41% versus 39% while recording cast costs; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R missing-health ramp and below-40% doubled branch are not freely multiplied together.

ruledOut.reason: R increases mana cost on repeated shots within eight seconds up to 400.

unknowns: Retained death-passive records disagree on base damage and final movement speed; no version is selected for a death-bomb route.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

builds.name: Ap Barrage Repeat
builds.summary: Log W on-hit packets during Dusk and fully stacked Rageblade.
builds.goal: Log W on-hit packets during Dusk and fully stacked Rageblade.
builds.hypothesis: W supplies eight seconds of AP-scaled max-health magic On-Hit and extra range; Q removes both resists. Nashor/Dusk/Rageblade tests a personal on-hit attack window with AP scaling and Phantom Hit, without assigning passive death damage to attacks.
testPlan: Required state: W active and Q shred lands; record Rageblade ramp and Dusk availability.
Log W on-hit packets during Dusk and fully stacked Rageblade; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low defense or delayed attacks wastes the eight-second duration.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated on-hits do not grant extra W duration or attack range.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing [100 / 140 / 180 + (0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45) × AP + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [0.83333]% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take [(100 / 140 / 180 + (0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45) × AP + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (2)] magic damage.

Subsequent shots within [8] seconds cost an additional [40] Mana (max: [400] Mana).

Passive: Kog'Maw gains [(0.05 / 0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2 / 0.25) × 100]% Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds [16 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 32]% Armor and Magic Resist for [4] seconds.
Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage and leaving a trail of ooze for [3] seconds. Enemies in the ooze are Slowed by [40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60]%.
